releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.3.0 — DPC Latency & Audio Buffer Watchdog:
- Kernel DPC/ISR Latency Telemetry: Real-time sampling of Deferred Procedure Calls and Interrupt Service Routines via NtQuerySystemInformation across all 12 CPU cores.
- DPC Spike Auto-Mitigation: Automatically resolves driver bus hangs (>1000 µs) in nvlddmkm.sys and ndis.sys by re-aligning interrupt moderation and multimedia queues.
- audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Watchdog: Locks audiodg.exe to dedicated CPU cores with Pro-Audio MMCSS priority to eliminate audio crackling and micro-stuttering.
- DirectX Desktop Duplication (DDA) 2X Interpolator.
- Tri-Pillar Performance Accelerator.
